description_full: Mach Natural Resources LP, an independent upstream oil and gas company, focuses on the acquisition, development, and production of oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGL) reserves. The company owns a portfolio of midstream assets, as well as owns gathering systems, processing plants. and water infrastructure. It also operates proved developed producing (PDP) wells. The company has operations in Anadarko Basin region of Western Oklahoma, Southern Kansas and the panhandle of Texas; the San Juan Basin region of New Mexico and Colorado; and the Permian Basin region of West Texas. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

financial_summary: Mach Natural Resources LP is a small-cap energy business with a $1.5B market cap on $1.2B of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +24% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are contracting by -13.1pp, the first warning that competitive pressure is eroding the franchise.

The business throws off $499M in free cash flow — roughly 42 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 3.55× so those profits are backed by real cash.
Accruals are elevated at -9.6% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 2.0× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and interest coverage runs at 3.4×.

Management returns a meaningful 20.0% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 23% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and within its sector the business captures 1.9× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
